notes.title: A wild Patch !!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The Good [i]and[/i] The Bad[/b][/h1]
Hello time travelers, today we have a really big announcement to make. So without further ado lets go over the fun stuff. First up we have quite the update list. There were a lot of things that happened over the past few days, one of them being that our major developer got another job. This is good news for the our developer, and we are happy to see them getting more work.
However, this means two things:
[olist]
	[*] we will have less updates for Flood in the future
	[*] our major developer will be leaving soon due to his new jobs needs
[/olist]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/alkainstudios/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779607/1a33cd0c0d42f406f64d121cfb9fad2224ef60e7.png[/img][/url]

[h1][u][i]Not stopping yet!![/i][/u][/h1]
However, that doesn't mean that we will be dropping the project just yet. There is still quite a bit of work left to get things to work the way they should but for now this is what we can do. We can't go into details as to why this is happening, but we can tell you that the our major developer just won't have very much time on their hands for the next few months.

[h1][b][i][u]The List!![/u][/i][/b][/h1]
Here is a list of things that have changed since release:
	[*] New color scheme for some of the text in the game.
	[*] The color of the text was changed to make it easier to read.
	[*] The Title screen options are now images and given a slight lean to them.
	[*] New UI update includes:
	[list]
		[*] Layout rework in the Main, Save, Equip, Item, and Option Menus.
		[*] Highlighting changed from whole word to a bar.
		[*] Quest Menu text color update to match the new scheme. (Still in progress)
		[*] Quest Menu text size change so that we can display more information.
	[/list]
	[*] We updated the gathering system to be a bit more predictable but still have some randomness to it.
	[*] Fixed some old art that was missed in from the "New Art Patch".
	[*] And more...
[/list]

[i]There is more however this is what we have available for this patch.[/i]

notes.title: It’s finally here!!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow time travelers. The [b][u]full game[/u][/b] launch of Flood: The Prequel. It has been a long time coming and now it’s time to jump in with both feet and play Flood. We hope you enjoy the game as much as we have enjoyed making it. In the event you find a bug in FloodTP, please report it to our bug channel and we will fix it in our next update. 

[h1]
Thank you all for your patients and have fun,
Dev Team
[/h1]

notes.content:
Greetings Time Travelers! NEW Battle System, Tutorial, Graphics and Hotkeys.

Battle System
- Completely reworked for better efficiency and more enjoyable game-play

notes.title: New patch brings us to Version 0.3.2
notes.content:
We want to say thank you to everyone who gave us feedback on the game thus far, your feedback is going to help us make this game great. Over the past few days, we have worked hard fixing as many bugs and issues that were brought to our attention as well as providing some additional content. "Looking at you axe." There is still quite a bit of work left to do, however, we wanted to fix certain aspects as soon as possible. 

[h1]The list below details what we changed with this update.[/h1]
[list]
+ Resting at the bed doesn't send you into an infinite loop on stuck. 
[/list]
[list]
+ Fixed the transfer event in the cellar of the Communal Hall. Now you won't get stuck in limbo.
[/list]
[list]
+ Added a new weapon to the game and placed it... somewhere... happy searching.
[/list]
[list]
+ You can now level up without your XP bar breaking and go into the negatives. If you didn't notice it was a problem before this update, we fixed it so no need to worry.
[/list]

notes.title: News
notes.content:
[b]Special Update[/b]

[h1]FTP is now at Version 0.3.0[/h1]

Hello everyone, we wanted give you guys a quick update on how things are going and a look at what we have done for this update. We'll leave a small list of changes made below, so feel free to read that over. Also, with this update we have added a few new hidden places. Can you find them all?

Hope you enjoy this update.
Until next time,
God Inspired Games

Here is a small update list of a few of the things that we have worked on.

[h1]Updates and Changes[/h1]
[b]Maps:[/b]
	- Forest changes and upgrades
	- Player's village house event updates (fixed crafting station)
	- Actors (Database)

[b]Enemies[/b]
	- All enemies properly give XP now
	- Balanced and rebalanced all the enemies currently in the game

[b]Cleaning[/b]
	- Searching in the fields now shows a 'gab' window rather than a 'text' window (this will clean up the screen and not require you to go through the text window you won't have the text window cramping your style)
	- Got rid of some images that we don't use (this makes the game smaller and takes up less space on your computer)

[b]Windowskin[/b]
	- New Windowskin
